title: List Product SKPP Statuses
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-10
html:
Path: /product/202606/skpps/search

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Batch query SKPP status for the seller's products.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
locale string N en The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying category information.
Default: The default locale of your shop.
Possible values:
  • en
  • en-GB
  • zh-CN
  • de-DE
  • id-ID
  • it-IT
  • ja-JP
  • ms-MY
  • pt-BR
  • th-TH
  • vi-VN。 |

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
product_ids []string N ["7345678901","7345678902"] Product IDs generated by Tiktok Shop; up to 100 per call.
skpp_status string N QUALIFIED Optional filter.
Possible values:QUALIFIED (already an SKPP product) / NOT_QUALIFIED (not yet meeting the standard, but eligible to take SKPP tasks).
page_size int N 50 Number of products returned per page. Range: 1–100. Default: 50.
page_no int N 1 Page number, starting from 1. Default: 1.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/202606/skpps/search?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&locale=en

Body

{"product_ids":["7345678901","7345678902"],"skpp_status":"QUALIFIED","page_size":50,"page_no":1}

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^products []object Product list, each with its SKPP status.。
^^product_id string 7345678901234567890 Product IDs generated by Tiktok Shop
^^title string Premium Cotton T-Shirt Product title.
^^skpp_status string QUALIFIED Possible values: QUALIFIED / NOT_QUALIFIED
^^affiliate_program_status string ACTIVE Affiliate Program enrolment status. Possible values: ACTIVE / INACTIVE.
^^total_score int 8 Current SKPP total score, as of update_time.
^^target_score int 7 Score threshold to qualify for SKPP.
^^rewards []object Rewards data.
^^^reward_type string ADS_CREDIT Possible values: ADS_CREDIT / TOP_CREATOR_MATCHMAKING / SHOPTAB_PV.
^^^status string AVAILABLE Possible values: NOT_GRANTED (below threshold, locked) / PENDING (qualified, not yet granted) / AVAILABLE (granted).
^^^value string $15 Granted amount/quantity; present only when status = AVAILABLE. Currency-typed (ADS_CREDIT) leads with the currency symbol (e.g. $15); count-typed (TOP_CREATOR_MATCHMAKING, SHOPTAB_PV) are bare numbers.
^^^ad_credit_claim_status string CLAIMED Ad-credit-only sub-status, returned only when reward_type = ADS_CREDIT and status = AVAILABLE. Possible values: UNCLAIMED (eligible, not yet claimed) / CLAIMED (claimed). Ad credit must be claimed manually.
^total_count int 1234 Total products matching the filter.
^update_time int 1779148799 Date of the offline data snapshot that total_score and rewards are derived from, returned as a Unix timestamp in seconds, pinned to the last second of that date in UTC (23:59:59Z). The value is date-level only — the time component is always 23:59:59 UTC — because the SKPP scoring runs in an offline pipeline with no intraday granularity. Latency is typically T+1 (the evening of day N publishes the day N−1 snapshot) and at most T+2.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"products":[{"product_id":"7345678901234567890","title":"Premium Cotton T-Shirt","skpp_status":"QUALIFIED","affiliate_program_status":"ACTIVE","total_score":8,"target_score":7,"rewards":[{"reward_type":"ADS_CREDIT","status":"AVAILABLE","value":"$15","ad_credit_claim_status":"CLAIMED"}]}],"total_count":1234,"update_time":1779148799},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
